Brandied Chicken | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon brandy | 1 pinch salt to taste 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Place the chicken bouillon powder, brandy, and salt into a resealable plastic bag. Pour the bouillon over the chicken, coating it evenly. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 2 hours, but not longer than 6 hours. Remove the chicken from the bag, and shake off any excess water. Pat the chicken dry, and wipe off any excess salt inside to prevent an unpleasant smell of spice. Wrap the bag in a piece of plastic wrap, place, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours, turning and rearranging from time to time. Bring the chicken to room temperature before baking, and bake at 375 degrees f for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until juices run clear, the coating is lightly browned, and no longer crusty.  ## Cooking instructions ##
 Place split peas and broth in medium soup pot.  Season with basil, celery seed, green onions and sugar.  Cover and cook over medium low heat for 45 to 50 minutes.  Remove cover and cook for 20 minutes longer, stirring occasionally, or more.  Use a spoon to mash the peas and broth.  Stir in cooked peas and cook for 15 minutes more.  Serve warm or chilled.
